case.title: Welcome to the United States: A Guide for New Immigrants (M-618-A, Arabic, rev. 09/15)
case.author: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services
case.provenance: Arabic edition linked from the USCIS Settling in the U.S. page. InDesign CS6 export with embedded Arial CID fonts and ToUnicode maps.
case.rightsBasis: U.S. Government work (17 U.S.C. 105). USCIS website policies call site information public, but state some images are licensed to USCIS and are not in the public domain; the guide contains photographs and a card specimen. Not relicensed under MIT.

rightsClearance.scope: USCIS public-information statement with a licensed-image exception; text is development material, images need separate review before any redistribution.

coverage: bidirectional runs mixing Arabic, Latin, form numbers and phone numbers
right-to-left table of contents with dot leaders
extraction reverses I-551 to 551-I and mirrors parentheses
photographs and callout boxes beside text
case.downloadVerification: Fresh download through tools/fetch_corpus.py into an empty temporary cache matched this identity on 2026-09-16; see measurements/corpus-candidates-30/verification.json.
case.reviewStatus: Converted with EPUBCheck, progress and 256 MiB Mac RSS gate. Contract protects the Arabic contents heading and entry order and page-21 Arabic text with embedded English terms. Bidirectional ordering is unqualified (#41).

knownFidelityIssues.issue: Right-to-left paragraphs with embedded numbers split into visual-line fragments; I-551 becomes 551-I, parentheses mirror and the phone number reverses.

case.baselineStatus: Baseline and reviewed contract recorded in measurements/uscis-m618-arabic-2015/record.md; included in the corpus gate.

memoryBudget.scope: macOS 27 arm64 isolated release CLI, defaults; initial RSS regression ceiling, not a mobile device budget
